ve it, what now?

If tracking shows delivered but you do not have the package, first check around your property, with household members, neighbors, your mailroom, parcel lockers, and any secure areas nearby. Carriers can also mark a package as delivered up to 48 hours before final placement. If it still does not turn up after 48 hours, please log in so we can review your specific order details and investigate further.
